textReplacements.source: The geometry of precast girders is governed by the geometry of the substructure and their position along the axis. Thus, a further modeling approach is available in Allplan Bridge that enables users to create an exact geometry of precast girder bridges easily and quickly. The modeling process is optimized even further by using parametric 3D templates. In this way repetitive bridge elements, such as straight precast girders, have to be defined only once and then placed parametrically as many times as necessary.

Düz prefabrik kirişler gibi tekrarlanan köprü elemanları yalnızca bir kez tanımlanır ve gerektiği kadar parametrik olarak yerleştirilir.
